name: Delta Electronics, Inc.
summary: Delta Electronics, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides power and thermal management solutions in Mainland China, the United States, Taiwan, Thailand, and internationally. It operates through Power Electronics, Mobility, Automation, and Infrastructure segments.
